gloss_en: Ge'ulah — the Redemption: the national-messianic deliverance of Israel from exile, brought about through repentance and faith (as in 'in Nissan they are destined to be redeemed')

outliers.actual_gloss_en: exile (Aramaic galuta, 'they will go out from the exile through it')
outliers.reason: The word גאולה does not actually appear here; the vocalized form is the Aramaic גָּלוּתָא (exile) in the Zohar phrase יִפְקוּן בֵּהּ מִן גָּלוּתָא. Redemption is only implied by negation of exile — a different lexeme, so a form-level mis-assignment.
